blockers.detail: Cleanup errors only mark a completed job result; the job is removed from jobs and later dispose resolves. A pre-release underlying handle disposal failure can leave owned resources live while the caller is told the disposal barrier completed.
blockers.requiredFix: Persist cleanup failure in executor lifetime and reject/report unsafe disposal after draining, including errors from already completed jobs; retain committed returned outcome separately. Test a real owned-handle wrapper failure before release, then manually clean up the fixture.

Runtime-owned in-memory events, not persisted DSH Session-log evidence
